description: Department of Trade and Investment Policy - Finance Act.No.12 of 2012 Commercial Hub Regulations No.01 of 2024.
categorisation: This gazette content promulgates a new regulation ("Finance Act - Commercial Hub Regulations No. 01 of 2024") that amends existing commercial hub regulations. It contains detailed regulatory provisions governing LP gas sales, tax obligations, and compliance requirements. While it mentions the Minister of Finance by name, the primary focus is on establishing legal/regulatory framework rather than government personnel changes or portfolio assignments. The content fits Type 5 (Legal/Regulatory) as it involves statutory instruments, regulatory amendments, and compliance requirements under the Finance Act.
